Fact.Name: Property basis reduction (before personal credit tax limitation)
Fact.Description: The basis reduction for this property: Schedule A lines 16 plus 21, the credit determined before the section 30C(d) tax limitation, unless the filer elects not to claim the credit. It lowers the property's basis for every later purpose, including its depreciable basis on Form 4562 Part III column (c), whose instructions list this credit among those that reduce the basis for depreciation. Form 4562 rows are class totals the filer enters, not linked to Form 8911 properties, so no module subtracts this figure automatically: the application shows it on the depreciation screen and the filer enters the reduced basis there.

Fact.Name: Form 8911 Item A: number of qualified refueling properties
Fact.Description: Form 8911 Item A, the total number of qualified alternative fuel vehicle refueling properties for which the credit is claimed, one Schedule A (Form 8911) per property. It counts the entered properties whose /form8911Properties/*/eligible is true; a property that fails eligibility earns no credit and is not counted. With no property entered (including a return whose only credit is the partnership or S corporation amount on line 2) the count is 0, which is the printed "enter -0-" rule. An unanswered property collection is also 0; properties entered but not marked complete leave the count Incomplete, the same gate line 1 uses.

Fact.Name: Form 8911 line 2, complete-safe
Fact.Description: Form 8911 line 2, the alternative fuel vehicle refueling property credit from partnerships and S corporations, floored at $0; $0 when the filer leaves the line blank, so line 3 and the Form 3800 Part III line 1s amount it feeds resolve on every return that has no such credit.

Fact.Name: EIN of the partnership or S corporation that passed through the Form 8911 line 2 credit (Form 3800 Part III line 1s column (c))
Fact.Description: Question: "What is the employer identification number (EIN) of the partnership or S corporation that passed this alternative fuel vehicle refueling property credit through to you? If more than one did, enter the EIN of the one that allocated you the largest amount." Help text: the EIN is on the Schedule K-1 that reports the credit. Asked when /writableForm8911Line2 is more than $0. Unanswered: Form 3800 Part III line 1s column (c) prints blank; no amount reads it. Validation: a nine-digit EIN. Feeds form3800 /form3800PartIiiLine1sColumnCPassThroughEntityEin. BOUNDARY: the Form 3800 instructions list each pass-through entity separately in Part V when more than one allocated the same credit; this dictionary holds one pass-through total per credit, so that breakdown is not printed.

Fact.Name: Form 8911 line 3: business credit for Form 3800 Part III line 1s
Fact.Description: General business credit component before Form 3800 limitations, passive restrictions, transfers and carryovers: line 1 plus line 2, a blank line 2 counting as $0. Form 3800 Part III line 1s reads it. Do not add this directly to Schedule 3 line 6a; use the Form 3800 allowed credit there.

Fact.Name: Form 8911 line 8
Fact.Description: Form 8911 line 8, the tentative minimum tax an individual copies from Form 6251 line 9: form6251 /amtLine9TentativeMinimumTaxAfterAmtftcFloored, line 7 less the line 8 AMT foreign tax credit, floored at zero. Line 7 less the credit is the section 55(b)(1) amount that section 26(c) makes the tentative minimum tax for this credit, whether or not the filer owes AMT. The floor keeps a negative line 9 (a foreign tax credit above line 7) from raising the line 9 limit above the net regular tax. The reasons for both are on the shared fact.
